scope: Lease-tail exploratory cross-suite replication of independent-clock action-selection semantics
research_question: Does the direction observed on LIBERO Spatial persist on LIBERO Object when checkpoint, deadline, clock, mailbox, hold rule, keyed sampling, tasks, episodes, and joint seed are fixed between action-selection modes?

pairing_gate.unit: task_id plus episode_index within joint seed 7
pairing_gate.failure_disposition: Preserve both artifacts but make no paired method-effect claim.

analysis_plan.success_test: Report discordant counts and the exact two-sided McNemar test for the 40 registered pairs.
analysis_plan.process_metrics: Report paired differences descriptively by task and episode.
analysis_plan.pooling: Do not pool this Object seed with the frozen Spatial-240 study or the earlier Object episodes 0:3 deadline cells.
analysis_plan.negative_result_policy: Retain and report a null or reversed result; do not add deadlines, episodes, or modes after inspection.

execution_gate: Run the two cells serially against the same attested policy service.
Start the second cell only if at least 25 minutes of the server lease remain.
Each cell must pass the independent artifact validator before its result is interpreted.
Both cells must be archived with SHA-256 sidecars and downloaded before lease expiry.
stop_conditions: provider failure, missing inference/simulation overlap, worker not stopped, or validator invalid
checkpoint attestation, OpenPI commit, runtime commit, or source hashes differ between modes
do not stop a 40-rollout cell based on intermediate task success
claim_boundaries: exploratory one-seed cross-suite replication, not confirmatory external validation
one attested pi0.5 checkpoint, not cross-model generality
not an official LIBERO leaderboard score
not hardware safety or real-robot deployment evidence
query-0 pairing does not imply later observations remain identical after the modes diverge
